input: exact experiment 21 baseline-only 16 features; no repository identity or outcomes in inference
hypothesis: a shallow nonlinear predictor of saved pages can isolate rare useful helper calls; architecture and objective both change, so gains cannot be attributed to nonlinearity alone
target: ceil(baseline_rank/20)-ceil(interleaved_rank/20), no clipping or resampling, ties have target zero
fit: deterministic greedy binary regression tree minimizing within-leaf squared error; leaf prediction is training mean saved pages; all 16 features; sorted value thresholds; strict improvement; equal-gain ties use smaller feature then earlier split
model_bound: at most 31 nodes, 4 comparisons per score; SoA arrays; float64 thresholds and means; no pretrained weights, quantization or GPU
folds: unchanged test i/train i+1/validation i+2 over etcd, test-infra, lxd
selection: for each of eight candidates, existing validation-only 90% page-budget calibration; select minimum validation pages, tie fewer calls, then smaller maximum depth, then larger minimum leaf; held-out outcomes never select candidate
primary: validation-selected tree; deterministic algorithm has no random seed; identical rerun is reproducibility, not independent evidence
controls: frozen experiment 21 selected seed1729/2718 heads and gap rule; verify source package hashes before replay; no refitting controls
diagnostics: benefit/harm/page-tie counts; selected-call confusion by page effect; missed beneficial pages and incurred harm; oracle calls iff saved pages>0 is labeled non-deployable; report top10 separately because page ties can alter quality
gate: unchanged 21/20/15: pages<=always-helper, calls<=90%, Recall1/10>=raw, and learned policy Pareto dominates gap pages/calls with at least one strict gain; also report comparison with both 21 seeds without silently adding or removing gates
resources: score allocations and latency on synthetic trees, full process wall and peak RSS separately; no LLM cost conversion
replay: 24 trees and aggregate output must be byte-identical on full rerun; malformed input and train/heldout isolation tests
independence: existing repeatedly observed documentation queries, no fresh final or actual-agent evidence; unused CoSQA reserves remain unscored
